title: Garazeb Orrelios
description: A former member of the Lasat honor guard, Garazeb Orrelios—Zeb to his friends and found family—joined the fight against the Empire with the Rebellion as the muscle for Phoenix Squadron. Despite his size and strength, he was far from the dim-witted brute one might expect. With his Lasat bo-rifle in hand, he fought valiantly in many battles but remained haunted by the razing of his planet by the Empire at the hands of Agent Kallus. He thought himself to be the last of the Lasan but was shocked to find that there were still more of his people left alive.
